summary: Offline-safe feature flags and monetization parameters over Firebase Remote Config, with declared defaults and a deterministic test double.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.why: Required to fetch feature flags and parameter values from Firebase Remote Config.

dataCollected.notes: Firebase Installations generates and sends a per-installation identifier required by Remote Config fetch requests.
Remote Config automatically collects country code so parameters can be targeted by coarse location.
Remote Config sends app/package identifiers, SDK and app platform versions, OS version, language, and time zone to select and deliver parameter values.

policyNotes: Including Remote Config also includes Firebase Installations; Data safety must disclose the installation identifier even when Analytics is not present.
This capability does not include Firebase Analytics. A slot that adds Analytics or enables Remote Config personalization must add the resulting collection to its disclosures.
Remote parameters must not weaken safety, privacy, paid-feature access, or other policy-critical behavior below the reviewed defaults shipped in the app.
